profile.headline: Software Developer Specialist at Nasdaq
profile.summary:
My interest in computers started at age eight; it was the first time I had seen or used one, and I was instantly amazed by it. Looking back, that is where my love of computers began. I finished my studies in Computer Science Engineer and after my graduation worked as a software developer for about 6 years.

During this time, I get professional experience that helped me understand project management, respecting deadlines, and improving my computer science abilities, as well as my problem-solving and analytical skills helping companies in Mexico and USA to meet their goals within software developer areas. I volunteer for an organization based on NY and from this experience, I realized the importance of helping others in my community and it made me feel proud of my contributions when these are beneficial for people in need.

Currently self-learning new technologies and seeking to further improve my technical skills.

positions.title: Graduated LEAD program
positions.description: Participated of the LEAD workshop series at the NYPL.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop the ticket sales portal for the annual gala event and maintain the organization’s main website.
• Develop the Royal C Pop website that will help diffusion of artists' work for potential partners.
• Collaborated closely with organization’s founder allowing flexibility, and ability to respond to changes quickly.

positions.title: Java System Analyst
positions.description:
• Implemented thread management solutions within backend processes for paperless billing reducing response time from 12 to 3 hours.
• Developed web services to provide information from clients into user’s registration process.
• Designed and developed marketing’s massive SMS system which increased efficiency of marketing process from 40 to just 8 hours of working time.
• Self-Learned of IBM ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), IBM BPM (Business Process Manager) for SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) to start the implementation of SOA using IBM’s tools.

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description:
• Proactively found and fixed security vulnerabilities within the bank’s internal system's login, strengthening the system’s security and obtaining recognition from the security manager.
• Developed and maintained front-end bank’s investment fund system (Swing), and back-end web services for bank’s fiduciary system.
• Completed complex queries, triggers, and updates within Oracle data base for conciliation batch processes. • Generated and presented user documentation -for end-users- that included tutorials, user guides, etc.

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description:
•	Designed and corrected schemes UML (Unified Modeling Language) with IBM Rational Enterprise Architecture for Infonavit client.
•	Worked with Apache Subversion.
•	Developed software documentation for ‘Plataforma de Afiliacion Universal’ Infonavit (Affiliate universal platform), and presentations for customers and system users.
•	Functional testing.
•	Trained in software technologies like Servlets, JSP (Java Server Pages), JSF (Java Server Faces) and EJB (Enterprise Java Beans) for potential future projects.
